incidents.name: ZZF burnToHolder spot-price reward drain
incidents.notes: ZZF.burnToHolder() valued burned ZongZi with a live uniswapRouter.getAmountsOut quote against WBNB, so after a flash-loaned pump of the WBNB/ZongZi pair the attacker's burn plus receiveRewards() paid out almost the whole BNB balance held by the ZongZi token contract.

sources.ref: onchain review of verified ZZF source at 0xb7a254237e05ccca0a756f75fb78ab2df222911b: burnToHolder() computes 'deserved' via uniswapRouter.getAmountsOut(amount, [_burnToken, WETH]); contract created 2024-02-08 by 0x95bf53764944fe19629f0e38f0edb02762cfff7c, not by attack sender 0x2c42824ef89d6efa7847d3997266b62599560a26
